description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'EmployeeAllowedLicenseAPI' used for fetching allowed licenses for employees in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving license data with filtering, pagination, and sorting, as well as handling validation rules. The class extends a base Endpoint and implements CollectionEndpoint, indicating it provides collection-based API responses.
